source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    1. Power on the SUT with the power button.
2. Power off the SUT with the power button.

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria:
(Depends on project design)
1. Physical and WebUI Power button should be green when system booted.
2. Physical and WebUI Power button should be orange when system in standby.
3. Physical and WebUI Power button should flash in green 5~6 min when system power on and solid on green light after system booted.

deepseek_columns.ai_commands:
-- Front Panel Power Button: agent powers the SUT on/off via OOB IPMI; the front-panel Power LED color (green/orange) is visual and the physical button press is operator-only (agent only drives the power command).
ipmitool -I lanplus -C 17 -H "$BMC_IP" -U "$BMC_USER" -P "$BMC_PASS" chassis power on 2>&1; sleep 5; ipmitool -I lanplus -C 17 -H "$BMC_IP" -U "$BMC_USER" -P "$BMC_PASS" chassis power status 2>&1
deepseek_columns.ai_logs_output: return the ipmitool power command result + `ipmitool power status` after on/off; the power-button LED color is operator-visual.
deepseek_columns.risk: RISK: power cycling the SUT - confirm the machine is dedicated before cycling.

historical_reviews.deepseek: PARTIAL incorrectly makes OOB IPMI power control the stimulus; that reaches a power state without testing the physical button, debounce/wiring or physical LED. Its status read is supporting evidence and its `-P` credential form is unsafe.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION / CHANGED adds strong power-cycle safeguards and Project LED timing inputs, but still permits an IPMI control phase even though the Master procedure exclusively requires the physical button.
historical_reviews.round_02: Entry 813/2291 retains PARTIAL and documents an OOB routing fix, yet the corrected routing does not cure the functional coverage substitution.
historical_reviews.invalid_checkpoint_1000: Its non-counting sequence-978 draft was inspected only as history. This review independently separates momentary/long-press semantics, boot-transition timing and standby evidence while keeping all stimulus and optical acceptance manual.
historical_reviews.v3_1: ED-35 forbids replacing the physical functional test with a safer read-only or alternative control path; ED-36 treats Project color/timing and power policy as readiness inputs; ED-38 keeps physical power action and DUT verdict engineer-owned.

original_test_intent: Verify that the physical front-panel power button performs the Project-defined power-on and power-off transitions and that the corresponding physical and WebUI indications show the approved boot-transition, running and standby colors/timing.
original_method: A qualified operator uses the actual button to start the SUT and later power it off, while directly observing the physical indicator and WebUI representation and correlating them with host/BMC power and boot/shutdown state. OOB power commands are not equivalent stimuli.
manual_activity: A qualified operator verifies the exact chassis, applies the specified momentary/held physical button presses, observes physical and WebUI color/flash behavior, waits for the approved transition or abort, and restores the required final state. Automation may only collect read-only state and logs around those actions.
required_inputs: Project-specific matrix for mechanical button action, ACPI/firmware response, physical LED and WebUI indication in standby, booting, running, shutting down and off states
Approved press duration(s), debounce behavior, graceful versus forced-off semantics, shutdown timeout and whether the off step is permitted while the OS is active
Definition of boot complete and the expected 5~6-minute flashing interval, frequency/duty/tolerance, solid-green transition and orange standby state
Dedicated SUT identity, workload/data quiescence, filesystem/application protection, OOB/serial console, protected read-only BMC access, operator, abort and recovery plan
safety_requirements: Confirm immutable chassis identity, maintenance window, no active users/jobs/writes and safe shutdown readiness before touching the button.
Do not substitute IPMI, Redfish or WebUI power control for either physical-button operation; alternative controls may be recovery-only if separately approved and reported.
Do not use or drift into an unapproved long press, which may force immediate power removal. Record actual press duration and system response.
Observe boot/shutdown console and storage/application health; abort escalation on unexpected forced-off, hang, boot loop, error LED, BMC loss or time beyond the approved transition bound.
Do not infer physical color or flashing from power status. Capture timestamped physical and WebUI evidence throughout the 5~6-minute interval or actual Project-defined transition.
Use read-only OOB queries with protected credentials; do not expose passwords or issue state-changing power commands during the normal test.
Preserve first-failure logs, recover through the approved path only, verify clean host/filesystem and final physical/WebUI/BMC agreement, and do not retry automatically.
agent_execution_scope: Before execution, validate the button/state/timing matrix and safety package without changing DUT state.
After approval, collect read-only BMC power state, console/host boot and shutdown markers, audit/events and timestamps around engineer button actions; organize supplied physical/WebUI media.
Report physical power-on and physical power-off as distinct checkpoints, including actual press duration, transition timing and final indication agreement.
Do not press the button, issue IPMI/Redfish/WebUI power actions, claim optical observations, expose credentials, retry or issue DUT PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Approve the Project power-button/LED state matrix, press semantics, maintenance/data protection, transition limits and final state.
Operate the physical button, observe physical/WebUI indications and supervise console/OOB recovery.
Confirm clean recovery and state agreement, then issue per-transition and overall DUT verdicts.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: `chassis power status` can corroborate state, but `chassis power on` is a different control path and cannot validate the physical switch, debounce, wiring or LED path; plaintext command-line credentials are rejected.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Keep both stimuli manual. If approved, collect only protected read-only BMC/host/console state around physical presses; reserve remote power action for a separately authorized recovery path.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Physical power-on/off, Project-dependent green/orange behavior, 5~6-minute green flashing then solid green, no Script and 10/10-minute estimates remain unmodified.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Baseline a quiescent dedicated SUT; timestamp the approved physical press; record physical/WebUI indication and independent power/console milestones through boot; after health checks, perform the approved physical off press and capture graceful shutdown plus standby; verify final agreement and data integrity.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Exact chassis front-panel board/button/LED path and versioned BMC/BIOS/OS power policy.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record chassis/PCA, BMC, BIOS, CPLD/front-panel controller, OS and WebUI revisions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Project front-panel LED/power-button, ACPI/shutdown and boot-timing specifications.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds press-duration, clean-shutdown, timing and independent state evidence without replacing the physical actions.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: OOB power control omits the function under test; read-only OOB state is partial evidence only.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: State matrix, press/power policy, timing, safe window and recovery.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: An unintended long press or unclean power removal can corrupt active data even when the LED reaches an expected color.

project_override_considerations: Project SPEC controls colors, WebUI mapping and timing, but an override using remote power control must be labeled different-path coverage and cannot claim the Master physical-button function PASS.
expected_evidence: Approved Project state/LED/timing and button-press matrix with chassis/firmware/OS identity and final-state requirement
Dedicated/quiescent SUT authorization, protected recovery path, baseline physical/WebUI indication and read-only BMC/host state
Power-on press duration and timestamp; physical/WebUI green flash media across the defined interval; power, POST/boot and solid-green milestones
Power-off press duration and timestamp; graceful OS shutdown, physical/WebUI orange standby and BMC power-state correlation
Unexpected log review, clean filesystem/application/host recovery, final indication/state agreement, coverage gaps and engineer-owned verdicts

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Procedure consistently requires the physical button and Criteria explicitly defer colors/timing to Project design. Missing platform values are readiness inputs; the IPMI substitution appears only in prior AI guidance and is rejected.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The physical operations and acceptance dimensions are coherent. Once Project values and a safe maintenance plan exist, an engineer can execute the test; manual ownership does not make it permanently blocked.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Keeps only its state-query concept as supporting evidence and rejects its remote power stimulus plus exposed credential form.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Retains its safety/package requirements but reclassifies to MANUAL ONLY because every Master stimulus and the optical acceptance are physical/manual.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.round_02: Shows that correct OOB routing is irrelevant to functional equivalence and restores the button as the tested interface.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.invalid_checkpoint_1000: Agrees on no substitution and adds separate momentary/held semantics, transition sampling and clean-shutdown proof.

review_improvement: Prevents a remote power command from producing a superficially correct LED/status result while bypassing the actual switch and front-panel path, and makes an otherwise risky physical power-off auditable for cleanliness.
independent_technical_reasoning: The same final chassis power state can be reached through multiple controllers, but only a physical press exercises the Master target. Read-only OOB evidence can improve observability without changing coverage. Because both stimulus and optical result require an operator, MANUAL ONLY is more accurate than package-assisted execution; Project-specific values affect readiness, not that classification.
